Sant Gervasi - la Bonanova — Barcelona, Spain

No concerns found day Average night

In detail

No evidence of pickpocketing/scam risk to travellers. The one substantial press pattern is a 2023 squatting conflict at specific occupied buildings ('Kubo' and 'Ruïna'), where neighbours reported threats and violence from squatters, requiring a special Mossos operation. This was a localized, building-specific conflict that appears to have de-escalated after 2023 evictions. Sources checked: elindependiente.com, Nov 2023; infobae.com, May 2023; libremercado.com, May 2023.
